sources.snippet: Siliconed Generate and edit images on your Mac, locally, with recent open-weight models: computed in full precision, checked against the original code, and never using more memory than a fixed budget. Siliconed is a free, open-source macOS app for local text-to-image generation and AI image editing on Apple silicon Macs (M1 and later).
